title: The Basilisk’s Backward Hat Parade
description: The basilisk leads the spring milliners’ parade with its bonnet bow turned forward. A few admirers have already been turned to stone, hats and all.
alt: A green, roosterlike basilisk in a pink bonnet holds a mirror as milliners and stone figures follow it down a flower-strewn street.
pairing: A spring milliners’ parade × a basilisk in a backward bonnet
